preconditions.description: The number of test cases q must be between 1 and 10000.
For each test case, k must be at least 1 and at most n, and n must not exceed 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if not any((t[i] == s[i+j] for j in range(k)) for i in range(n-k+1) for t in ['0'*k, '1'*k]) else True
postconditions.description: If no beautiful string exists, output 'NO'; otherwise, output 'YES' followed by the lexicographically smallest beautiful string.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == 2 and stdout.splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and len(stdout.splitlines()[1]) == k
postconditions.description: If a beautiful string exists, the output must consist of two lines: 'YES' and the beautiful string of length k.
